passages.excerpt_preview: The article examines the hunger strike, voluntary arrest and courtroom performance as practices that entered a late-colonial field shaped by satyagraha, suffering and public moral persuasion.

passages.excerpt_preview: This does not erase the HSRA’s use of force or Gandhi’s commitment to nonviolence; it explains why the opposition cannot be reduced to a single binary.
hattacharya cautions against treating Bhagat Singh simply as the violent opposite of Gandhi.
